title: Memorizing songs and busking requests for singers
summary: He explains musicians had to memorize everything and improvise accompaniment for patrons, a skill he says young players now cannot get.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: Did you work at all from sheet music? Or did you have to memorize all the songs?

Oh, no. You had to memorize them. I mean, you'd look out of date, putting up sheet music up there. You know, you'd memorize them. In fact, you'd memorize the words too, because the singers like Mary Stafford, and all like that, you were there, you'd be considered the biggest ham in the world if you put up a piece of sheet music, you know, like the P & R copy, you'd better not have those on there.

You'd have to memorize it. And, then, we learned how to improvise, too. See, and it got so that you could -- if somebody come up to the piano and said, "Do you know, 'Hallelujah, I'm Home'"? You'd say -- we'd never say no, because maybe he had a dollar or fifty cents. You'd say, "Yes, I know it." I'd say, "What key do you sing it in?" He'd say, "Well, give me a key." Well, you would follow him -- you don't know the song, but you know the chords, and when he'd say, "I'm goin downtown --", you'd sing, "I'm going downtown --", you know

what I mean? But now, you don't know what is next, and you have to wait. You're just a little behind him. And he says, "That's good, that's good." But you don't know the song at all. I tell you. So you got away with it because -- that's what I mean when I say that nowadays, kids don't have that chance. Unless they're way down in BIP-BOP somewhere, where they just use the piano and people come in and say -- but around here and everything is high powered, New York, (unintelligible).
Where you going to get that practice anymore. That's one thing that's against us.
I mean, that's bad for the musicians that want to be really -- to be a THOROUGH musician, you have to know those things.
